title: context·skill catalog·native binding

acceptance_evidence.CACHE-TAIL: passed - identical stable blocks with differing run id/budget tail produce identical stable raw digests (test_cache_tail_stable_digest_identical)
acceptance_evidence.CACHE-TOOLS: passed - tool inventory change advances the epoch generation; contexts never mix (test_cache_tools_new_epoch_no_mixing)
acceptance_evidence.CACHE-UNKNOWN: passed - missing provider cache metrics normalize to null; never reported as 0 hits (test_cache_unknown_missing_metrics_null)
acceptance_evidence.CACHE-WIRE: passed - CompiledContext.wire_observed is false for locally assembled context (test_cache_wire_not_observed)
acceptance_evidence.CACHE-TOKEN: passed - a hard token gate cannot be passed on a byte estimate; CONTEXT_LIMIT_UNKNOWN (test_cache_token_byte_estimate_never_gates)
acceptance_evidence.UH-CACHE-01: passed - same release/profile/memory view with different task tails keeps identical block digests (test_uh_cache_01)
acceptance_evidence.UH-CACHE-04: passed - request_id/time land only in the dynamic tail; stable digest unchanged (test_uh_cache_04_ids_stay_dynamic)
acceptance_evidence.UH-CACHE-07: passed - unknown context limit refuses admission with CONTEXT_LIMIT_UNKNOWN rather than inventing a bound (test_uh_cache_07)
acceptance_evidence.UH-CACHE-08: passed - oversized tool output becomes bounded excerpt + digest + artifact ref; full text never auto-injected (test_uh_cache_08)
acceptance_evidence.UH-CACHE-09: passed - compaction manifest re-checks obligation/approval/blocker/evidence refs (test_uh_cache_09_full_refs_pass)
acceptance_evidence.CON-CTX-01: passed - changed observation tail keeps the stable prefix digest (test_con_ctx_01)
acceptance_evidence.CON-CTX-02: passed - tool schema change produces a new epoch and tool_inventory_digest (test_con_ctx_02)
acceptance_evidence.CON-CTX-03: passed - only selected skill bodies load; digest mismatch rejected (test_con_ctx_03_lazy_body_loading, test_con_ctx_03_body_digest_mismatch_rejected)
acceptance_evidence.CON-CTX-04: passed - compaction summary missing a required obligation ref fails OBLIGATION_LOSS (test_con_ctx_04)
acceptance_evidence.CON-CTX-05: passed - permit revoked before commit refuses the bind (test_con_ctx_05_revoked_permit_pauses_bind)
acceptance_evidence.CON-CTX-06: passed - changed file digest on restore raises STALE_EVIDENCE (test_con_ctx_06)
acceptance_evidence.CON-CTX-07: passed - no tokenizer means the limit is reported as unknown, not estimated (test_con_ctx_07)
acceptance_evidence.CON-CTX-08: passed - required blocks over budget raise CONTEXT_BUDGET (test_con_ctx_08)
acceptance_evidence.CON-CTX-09: passed - duplicate block ids raise INPUT_INVALID (test_con_ctx_09)
acceptance_evidence.CON-CTX-10: passed - identical stable bytes regardless of input order (test_con_ctx_10)
acceptance_evidence.CON-CTX-11: passed - deleted artifact resolves to ARTIFACT_UNAVAILABLE (test_con_ctx_11)
acceptance_evidence.CON-CTX-12: passed - external doc content is an untrusted citation; no authority change (test_con_ctx_12)
acceptance_evidence.CON-CAC-01: passed - TTL measured from request start; 301s > 300s is expired (test_con_cac_01)
acceptance_evidence.CON-CAC-02: passed - prefix warm effect judged only by provider usage, never by timing (test_con_cac_02)
acceptance_evidence.CON-CAC-03: passed - different model identity yields a different epoch (test_con_cac_03)
acceptance_evidence.CON-CAC-04: passed - unobserved upstream route refuses warming with CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE (test_con_cac_04)
acceptance_evidence.CON-CAC-05: passed - pending user input defers warming (test_con_cac_05)
acceptance_evidence.CON-CAC-06: passed - warming defaults off; zero physical calls after idle (test_con_cac_06)
acceptance_evidence.CON-CAC-07: passed - budget reservation contention admits exactly one winner (test_con_cac_07)
acceptance_evidence.CON-CAC-08: passed - late warm response is billed and marked stale (test_con_cac_08)
acceptance_evidence.CON-CAC-09: passed - omitted cache counters stay null; coverage gap visible (test_con_cac_09)
acceptance_evidence.CON-CAC-10: passed - unknown inclusive semantics leaves the ratio unresolved (test_con_cac_10)
acceptance_evidence.CON-CAC-11: passed - restarted monotonic clock yields unknown TTL, not a guarantee (test_con_cac_11)
acceptance_evidence.CON-CAC-12: passed - keepalive ping updates reachability only; cache fields stay null (test_con_cac_12)
acceptance_evidence.WP05-I01: passed - epoch derives from the intersection of policy/session/approval/role inputs (tool inventory, model, release, profile, memory view)
acceptance_evidence.WP05-I02: passed - memory release is pinned in the epoch; view changes produce a new epoch; revoked entries are never served (test_uh_cache_05/06)
acceptance_evidence.WP05-I03: passed - compaction and offload recover contract/approval/blocker/evidence ids; unknown limits are never invented

explicit_blocks: dev.py quality still exits 1 on pre-existing overlay-wide debt; the ~40 line-length findings in tests/unit_tests/cyrano/test_foundation.py predate WP05 (only one test there was edited) and stay baseline
real provider cache metrics are unobserved by design; UsageReport marks wire_observed=false and never fabricates hits
not_established: native dcode prompt-assembly integration (context compiles deterministically; WP06 wires the attempt port)
provider-specific cache behavior (no live provider calls)
real tokenizer enforcement (hard gate refuses without one; byte budget remains a diagnostic estimate)
EpochManager.update cannot explicitly clear a route to unobserved (route=None means keep current); callers set route at epoch_for time
review_findings: duplicate block ids remapped to INPUT_INVALID per the acceptance contract
cache_read_ratio now requires inclusive_semantics=True; the pre-existing unit test was updated to pass it explicitly
untrusted citations render as a marked block with zero authority
authority_scope: deterministic context assembly and honest cache accounting; no provider or native-runtime claim
next_wp_impact: WP06 binds compile_context/bind_context/epochs into the attempt port; WP11 memory releases pin through MemoryView
